# Main CPU, E-M10 Mark II 1.4

Main CPU for E-M10 Mark II 1.4: MN103 base ISA without AM33, cores CPU0 to CPU2.

**Category:** platform · **Main CPU:** MN103 base ISA (no AM33 or AM33-2), cores CPU0 to CPU2 · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M10 Mark II firmware 1.4, build 1400](../firmware/em10-ii-1400.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M10 Mark II](../cameras/em10-ii.md)

Unlike the AM33-2 bodies in the Atlas, the main code uses no AM33 instructions; fenykl rejects them in plugin code. The core id register reads 0, 1 or 2.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): The target description states the core is MN103 base ISA and runs an ISA check that rejects AM33 instructions in plugin builds. Source: [fenykl E-M10 Mark II target description](../sources/fenykl.target.md).
- **Static analysis** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): The symbol table states three cores (core id 0, 1, 2) and classifies functions by the cores that call them. Source: [fenykl firmware symbol table for E-M10 Mark II 1.4](../sources/fenykl.fwapi.md).

**[Full detail upstream](https://github.com/atx/fenykl/blob/dd8dde0ead63bfc2a722f65a7b86e19577ad9778/sdk/arch/em10ii/target.toml)**
